span.p:

and only if it has no untried child already

span.p:
the child joins with a flat prior
the parent stays active and keeps competing

span.p:
a sibling inside 0.15 cosine, both means > 0.5,
and provably not a relative

span.p:
canonical child inherits min(successes) and max(failures)
both parents survive as status='merged'

span.p:
Bedrock authors the genome. Anything failing
PlaybookDraft validation is stillborn:
logged with its payload, never inserted,
never executed.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
It breeds on the way down — that is the
entire point of the mechanism. expires_at
is deliberately left alone: the 90-day clock
measures disuse, not disgrace.
